identifiers.source:
import "@nx/visualizer"

type Step = { id:string title:string next?:string }

visualizer Step =
  <ElementVisualizer title=title>
    <PropertyVisualizer of=id format=id />
  </ElementVisualizer>

let first = <Step id="welcome" title="Welcome" next="details" />

colors.source:
import "@nx/visualizer"

type Color = string

type Brand = { name:string primary:Color accent?:Color note?:string }

visualizer Color = <ValueVisualizer format=color />

let brand = <Brand name="Hive5" primary="#b6695d" accent="not a color" note="#ffffff" />

attributeComments.source:
import "@nx/visualizer"

type Item = { name:string note:string }
type Step = { id:string title:string }

visualizer Step = <ElementVisualizer id=id />

let rowed =
  <Item
    name= /* why */ "a"
    note="n"
  />

let headed =
  <Item name= /* c */ "a"
    note="n"
  />

let keyed =
  <Step id= /* key */ "s"
    title="t"
  />

groupIdAtEnd.source:
import "@nx/visualizer"

type Choice = { value:string label:string note:string }

visualizer Choice = <ElementVisualizer title=label id=value idPosition=end />

let choice =
  <Choice value="yes" label="Yes"
    note="Agrees"
  />
